wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the entry points are library calls; a thrown error is the documented refusal, and the security tests only require that no code runs and no match is returned, so a crash-shaped refusal is indistinguishable from a clean one and cannot be isolated as a separate wrong fix
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: no resource or authorisation object is involved; the protected object is the evaluator and the values it reaches
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: query evaluation has no roles, peers or directions; every route reads values and then optionally calls them
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every route has to read a property before it can call anything, so a read-only guard is the protection itself rather than a one-sided variant of it
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or path is parsed and compared; the guarded decision is on the exact property name that the read selects
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the decision is made from the reached object and the property name alone; there is no authority or secret lookup that can return nothing
